title: Parabolic Anderson model on the Sierpiński carpet
page_description: An interactive solution of the parabolic Anderson model on a finite approximation of the Sierpiński carpet.
model_caption: One realization of the Itô parabolic Anderson model with Neumann boundary conditions and space–time white noise. The initial profile is a nonnegative localized bump with nontrivial support.
reading_caption: Use ln u to make small positive values easier to see, or u to inspect peaks. The mass and maximum readouts keep the solution’s absolute scale visible.
positivity_caption: Zero-valued cells appear in neutral gray in the log view. These plots illustrate individual finite approximations; they do not prove strict positivity or intermittency for the continuum model.
equation_accessible_text: The time derivative of u equals kappa times the Neumann carpet Laplacian of u plus lambda times u times space-time white noise.
